rationale: The 16 KiB main task runs startup and then the Worker trust parse (curve25519 key checks) on the same stack. A startup owner inlined into run_startup keeps its frame live underneath that parse; the queue-workaround image overflowed this way (run_startup grew from 1,776 to 4,896 bytes).

frames.reason: it stays live under bwg_worker_usb::prepare and the trust parse

standalone.reason: its ~4.4 KiB frame must be released before the Worker trust parse
